Title: [TC-2-PERF-01] POST /login meets SLA under 50 concurrent users
Description:
• Registered test users exist with valid credentials
• k6 is installed on the load generator
• Test environment is isolated from production
Test Data: concurrent_users: 50, duration: 60s, tool: k6, endpoint: POST /api/v1/auth/login, body: {"email":"user@test.com","password":"ValidPass1!"}
Step Action: Configure a k6 script to send POST /api/v1/auth/login with body {"email":"user@test.com","password":"ValidPass1!"} using 50 virtual users for 60s
Step Expected Result: k6 script validates and is ready to run

Step Action: Run the k6 script against the test environment
Step Expected Result: 50 virtual users start and requests are sent

Step Action: Monitor the k6 live output during the run
Step Expected Result: Requests complete with HTTP 200 and no connection errors

Step Action: Collect the k6 summary after 60s
Step Expected Result: Summary lists P95 latency, error rate, and throughput

Step Action: Compare the summary metrics with the SLA thresholds
Step Expected Result: TEST PASS — P95 < 500ms, error_rate < 1%, throughput > 50 req/s

Title: [TC-2-BOUND-01] Session active at 29m59s but expires at 30m00s

Step Action: Log in again with "user@test.com" and "ValidPass1!", then stay idle for 30 minutes 01 seconds
Step Expected Result: No interaction occurs during the idle period

Step Expected Result: User is redirected to /login and the session is not restored

Step Action: Observe the browser URL after the final redirect
Step Expected Result: TEST PASS — session valid at 29m59s, expired at 30m00s and 30m01s, URL reads /login
